Events Full Reference (Events Data Dictionary) | Events | Event Investigation | Documentation | Support and resources | Falcon
https://falcon.us-2.crowdstrike.com/documentation/page/e3ce0b24/events-data-dictionary
207/1226
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
TreeId
If this event is part of a detection tree, the tree ID it is part of.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
UID
Unix User Identifier.
GID
Unix Group Identifier.
UnixMode
Describes the traditional Unix permissions of a file system entry (eg. 0755).
OciContainerId
An OCI Container Id.
AccessTime
Unix access time, indicating last access NOTE: modifiable by users.
ChangeTime
Unix change time, indicating last status change or file modification. NOTE: This is the only timestamp which is not modifiable, unlike the
other file timestamps.
ModifyTime
Unix modify time, indicating last file modification. NOTE: modifiable by users.
